descriptor: Turn your AI chats into links you’ll be proud to share.
sampleTitle: A calmer way to build with AI

directions.name: Folio
headline: Your thinking,
worth sharing.
directions.mantra: Give good work a good form.
directions.rationale: The chosen Folio base, preserved with its icon in Ribbon. This is the reference for the three departures.
directions.alt: A fan of ivory book pages with a muted vermilion ribbon.
directions.markRationale: The retained Folio page-turn geometry, used in the warm accent color.

directions.name: Folio
headline: Good ideas,
clearly shared.
directions.mantra: Make the useful part easy to see.
directions.rationale: The shared thinking becomes the visual. Wide editorial margins and an oversized, text-led share replace the decorative hero.
directions.alt: A native typographic share with a concise title and three highlights.
directions.markRationale: The retained Folio page-turn geometry, used in the warm accent color.

directions.name: Folio
headline: Your thinking,
with character.
directions.mantra: A little personality. A clear idea.
directions.rationale: The book becomes a tactile paper collage. An asymmetric composition and a more expressive share card give Folio a handmade visual voice.
directions.alt: A sculptural paper collage of ivory pages and a rust ribbon, framed by muted blue and terracotta paper.
directions.markRationale: The retained Folio page-turn geometry, used in the warm accent color.

directions.name: Folio
headline: Thought through.
Ready to share.
directions.rationale: A warm evening atmosphere makes the cream share the brightest object. The product feels intimate and focused, with the work still in the foreground.
directions.alt: An ivory book and rust ribbon on dark walnut under warm evening light.
directions.markRationale: The retained Folio page-turn geometry, used in the warm accent color.
